tools.name: mouse_fix_status
tools.description: Report whether the Coopanion desktop-pet host is patched to stop per-event mouse forwarding: Coopanion version, host package version, each patched file and its state, backup location, and the last error. Read-only.

summary.zh: 查看桌宠的鼠标转发补丁是否已生效、备份在哪里、上次失败的原因。
summary.en: Reports whether the desktop-pet mouse-forwarding patch is in effect, where its backups are, and the last error.

tools.name: mouse_fix_apply
tools.description: Patch the installed Coopanion desktop-pet host now: force setIgnoreMouseEvents(..., { forward: false }) in the host and lease, set the cursor poll interval, and wrap the page pointermove handler so it runs at most once per animation frame. Idempotent; writes backups first. Restart Coopanion if the pet window is already running. Use this after a Coopanion update, or when auto-apply is off.

poll_ms.description: Cursor poll interval in milliseconds; 16 by default. Lower is more responsive, higher is cheaper.

summary.zh: 给当前安装的 Coopanion 桌宠打补丁：关闭逐事件鼠标转发，把光标轮询调到 16ms，并让页面 pointermove 每帧只处理一次；先备份，可重复执行。
summary.en: Patches the installed Coopanion pet host: disables per-event mouse forwarding, moves the cursor poll to 16 ms, and coalesces the page pointermove to one per frame; backs up first, idempotent.

tools.name: mouse_fix_restore
tools.description: Restore the desktop-pet host files from the backups this extension made, undoing the patch. Restart Coopanion afterwards. Refuses when the current files no longer match the patched state.

summary.zh: 用本扩展留下的备份还原桌宠宿主文件，撤销补丁；需要重启 Coopanion。
summary.en: Restores the desktop-pet host files from this extension’s backups; restart Coopanion afterwards.

changelog.0.1.2:
- npm/市场元数据：作者 funst（QQ 2674459204），MIT；主标题与介绍带中文，并补英文 locale。
- README / IMPLEMENTATION 明确“两次重启”激活流程：安装后重启，启用后再重启，否则不生效。
- 新增 `IMPLEMENTATION.md`（代码详细步骤与思路）。
- 0.1.1 的 host/page 补丁不变。
changelog.0.1.1:
- Fixes the remaining **drag stutter at 8000 Hz**. The desktop-pet page (`web/pet-app.js`) now
  records the latest `pointermove` and runs the original handler once per animation frame,
  instead of once per physical event; `body.pointer('move')` into the figure iframe is likewise
  at most once per frame. Pending moves are cleared on `pointerup`/`pointercancel`/`pointerleave`.
- The page patch is optional: if a future Coopanion changes that block, the host patch still
  applies and `mouse_fix_status` reports `pet-app.js: skipped`.
- `mouse_fix_status` now reports all three files.
changelog.0.1.0:
- First release.
- Patches the Coopanion desktop-pet host (`cortico-world-desktop-pet` 0.2.0, shipped with Coopanion 0.2.10/0.2.11) to call `setIgnoreMouseEvents(..., { forward: false })` and poll the cursor every 16 ms.
- Backups (`sha256`, content-addressed), state file, idempotent apply, exact-byte restore, and refusal on unknown host code.
- Tools: `mouse_fix_status`, `mouse_fix_apply`, `mouse_fix_restore`.
- Windows only.
